title: Heavenly Blue | Designer WaterColor Home | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Stay at Heavenly Blue, a designer WaterColor retreat with private pool, LSV, bikes, outdoor lounge, and near the beach.
description_expanded: Heavenly Blue Features - Large private pool and spa - can be heated for an additional fee October through April. Spa is heated at the same temperature as the pool (not a hot tub) - Lots of cushioned poolside seating plus sun shelf with umbrella in the pool - Complimentary Use of a 6-seater LSV (golf cart). Some restrictions apply and must sign a waiver to use the cart during your stay - Access to 4 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly to keep them in top shape - 2-minute bike ride or LSV drive to the Dragonfly Pool - 5-minute bike ride or LSV drive to Camp WaterColor (access included with your stay) - 4-minute drive to the WaterColor Publix plus dining at The Perfect Pig and Pizza by the Sea. - Covered outdoor lounge poolside with cushioned seating, gas fire pit, and TV - Sundeck with lounge seating and outdoor dining for 8 - Built-in outdoor propane grill - Enclosed outdoor shower - Driveway Parking for 4 vehicles (garage access not available) - Updated Designer interiors throughout the home - WIFI and cable - Sonos sound system - Chef's kitchen with Thermador appliances - HE washer and dryer in laundry closet - Dining for 8 around the dining table plus nearby breakfast bar seating for 4 - Access to the Watercolor Beach Club, Camp Watercolor, and all Watercolor community pools included with your reservation for 12 guests, age 5 and up. Additional passes are not available per HOA regulations - Community pools heated during cooler months and towel service available at Camp WaterColor as well as the WaterColor Beach Club (subject to change by the neighborhood) - Concierge services including grocery delivery, baby equipment rentals, and bike rentals available - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Welcome to Heavenly Blue! A private boutique resort experience in the popular WaterColor community. This home is overflowing with high-end amenities for a one-of-a-kind vacation experience. Newly updated, this designer luxury home is why you visit 30A and WaterColor! The first floor features a gourmet kitchen with appliances from Thermador, spacious dining area under artistic pendant lighting, and plush updated living room with room for your whole crew. There is also a Deluxe King Suite on the main floor, making traveling with the grandparents a breeze. The second floor includes another king suite, two queen guest suites and a bunk room with sleeping for 4 in two twin bunks. The expansive fenced in outdoor living space flows through the French doors of the living room to showcase a private pool, sun shelf and spa (pool and spa can be heated for an additional fee), outdoor dining area for 8, built-in propane grill, covered outdoor lounge with cushioned seating around a gas fire pit plus an outdoor TV, and landscaped yard. I guarantee you will spend most of your time out here! We provide the atmosphere, but you will need to bring your own poolside bartender. Don't forget about complimentary use of a LSV (golf cart) available with your reservation (some restrictions). Travel to the Beach Club and Camp WaterColor with ease. Seasonal on-demand trolley service is also available for travel throughout WaterColor. The Dragonfly community pool is a short walk away, and shopping and dining options are close by at the WaterColor Crossings shopping center.

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night

all: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
